audit_standard: ISO/IEC 27001, SOC 2 Type II, NIST SP 800-53, Zero-Trust WORM Attestation

DIR-ATTEST-04.enforcement: File permission locking (0o600) and persistent key verification.
DIR-ATTEST-04.name: Hardware-Rooted Identity & Signing
DIR-ATTEST-04.requirement: Execution keys and HMAC secrets must be stored locally with restricted permissions and protected via device-bound entropy sources.

DIR-AUDIT-05.enforcement: Automated assertion checks and traceback logging on tampering detection.
DIR-AUDIT-05.name: Continuous Self-Auditing & Verification
DIR-AUDIT-05.requirement: The system must verify its own WORM ledger integrity upon startup, mid-cycle, and prior to final deployment gate release.

DIR-CRYPTO-01.enforcement: Strict block validation on every read/write cycle; failure halts execution.
DIR-CRYPTO-01.name: Immutable Chain of Custody (WORM)
DIR-CRYPTO-01.requirement: Every state transition, log entry, and execution artifact must be cryptographically chained using SHA-256 and bound via HMAC-SHA256 signature verification.

DIR-SWARM-02.enforcement: Decentralized evaluation with automatic circuit breaking.
DIR-SWARM-02.name: 6-Role Executive Basis Consensus
DIR-SWARM-02.requirement: All deployments and state changes must pass through the 6-role Murmurations basis set (CDO, CISO, CRO, CLO, Ethics/RAI, CPO). Any single executive veto halts the pipeline.

DIR-TELEMETRY-03.enforcement: Runtime type and value validation prior to ledger sealing.
DIR-TELEMETRY-03.name: Float-Computed Zero-Stub Telemetry
DIR-TELEMETRY-03.requirement: Telemetry metrics (latency, error rate, model confidence) must be computed dynamically using floating-point arithmetic directly from raw event streams without stubs or mock values.
